import trimesh, numpy as np
m = trimesh.load("exports/model.box.e1af9484.stl")
v = m.vertices
axis = np.array([-30.5, 30.8])
d = np.hypot(v[:,1]-axis[0], v[:,2]-axis[1])
for x0,x1 in [(-30,-18.32),(18.32,30),(5.84-0.0,5.84)]:
    for pad,tag in [(0.0,"inside"),(0.6,"extended")]:
        mask = (v[:,0]>x0-pad)&(v[:,0]<x1+pad)&(d<3.0)
        sel = d[mask]
        print(f"x[{x0},{x1}] {tag}: count={mask.sum()}" + (f" min={sel.min():.3f} max={sel.max():.3f} mean={sel.mean():.3f}" if mask.sum() else ""))
# histogram of d for verts near knuckle 0
mask = (v[:,0]>-30.1)&(v[:,0]<-18.2)
print("all-vert dist hist near k0:")
h,edges = np.histogram(d[mask], bins=[0,1,1.5,2,2.3,2.6,3,3.4,4])
print(h, edges)
